binding_record_note: Exactly the default, size_t, int and copy constructor declaration for each ordered family. Compiler-emitted methods and trait bodies implement the tested domains; no global completion credit is granted.
changes: Default policy callbacks run after actual BaseMap construction; negative signed counts reject before policy construction. Added custom-allocator default constructors and signed common-allocator entry points through one shared macro.

BaseMapStorage is now the sole allocator handle owner in OrderedTable. Removed duplicate table handle and borrowed the allocator while constructing typed values; callbacks observe actual handle counts without synthetic adjustments.

Typed allocation and incremental lease acquisition remain atomic under the existing allocator mutex. Successful payload construction then transfers its original initialized allocation into its typed owner.

Copy construction uses an explicit incomplete-copy state. If copying throws after completed nodes exist, those nodes retain native raw ownership with no payload destructor or Free. The incomplete table releases only typed reset leases, clears non-owning graph references and retains base buckets until after hasher destruction.

Completed containers still destroy nodes in native bucket order, data keys before values, then the policy/base. Data copy construction retains Bind replacement behavior when a copied policy changes equivalence.

Added actual allocator reference-count observation, private typed-to-raw handoff and paired unsafe exact-layout re-adoption. Re-adoption acquires the reset lease under lock before returning a safe owner; callers must exclude concurrent reset/free while reacquiring it. Zero-sized owner recovery creates no phantom lease.

Native fixtures and Rust tests cover empty and successful copies, policy/hash/equality failures, every key/value construction failure position, explicit retained-node reclaim after native failure observations, and incremental reset reusing abandoned storage without payload destruction.
Shared allocation-owner and representative map, list, sequence, packed-map, indexed-map and cell-filter node suites are rerun alongside all 85 original ordered-map tests.
limitations: Scoped partial constructors are implemented and proven here; class-wide and global OCCT API/test parity remain incomplete.

Native completed-node leaks on constructor failure are intentionally preserved. Common/heap allocation failures can retain storage and payload resources indefinitely; tests use retaining arenas or explicitly reclaim only after recording the native failed state.

Common allocator absolute process reference counts depend on unrelated native static owners. Default/common tests compare actual +1/-1 deltas against the measured baseline, retain native stderr baseline counts, and do not claim identical ambient counts. Custom allocator observations compare exact absolute counts.

Rust Clone and injected policy operations do not reproduce every C++ user-defined copy/move-assignment or noexcept termination policy. Throwing payload destructors, copied-policy equivalence changes with user-defined value assignment, extreme allocation/count overflow and out-of-memory termination remain separately scoped domains.

Safe incremental Reset refuses while live typed source nodes remain; the native reset comparison occurs only after dropping the source and after failure releases its abandoned-node leases. The raw native reset-while-live domain is not presented as safe Rust parity.

Unsafe re-adoption requires exact initialized layout/provenance, a still-live original allocation with no remaining owner/lease, and external reset/free exclusion until lease acquisition. Arbitrary stale or foreign pointers are outside the contract.
Safe detached cursor identity registry overhead, non-transplantable cursor validation, safe set FirstNode unit views and arbitrary foreign bucket mutation remain representation/API adaptations.
Allocator handle observations for other operations, including caller-owned versus consumed replacement allocator arguments, remain outside these constructor tests.
Scoped native/compiler/Miri evidence does not replace whole-workspace validation or inventory completeness proof.
compiler_warning_note: Nightly rustdoc warnings outside this constructor scope are retained in raw output; scoped Clippy is run with warnings denied.
